definitions.explanation: The activity of buying and selling goods and services, especially on a large scale.

examples.japanese: {商業|しょうぎょう}{地区|ちく}に{行|い}く。
examples.english: To go to the commercial district.

examples.japanese: {商業|しょうぎょう}{活動|かつどう}が{盛|さか}んだ。
この{区域|くいき}は{商業|しょうぎょう}{地区|ちく}に{指定|してい}されている。
examples.english: This area is designated as a commercial district.

notes:
{商業|しょうぎょう} refers to commercial activities and trade.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {商業|しょうぎょう}{地区|ちく}: commercial district
- {商業|しょうぎょう}{施設|しせつ}: commercial facility
- {商業|しょうぎょう}{活動|かつどう}: commercial activity
- {商業|しょうぎょう}{主義|しゅぎ}: commercialism

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {商売|しょうばい}: business, trade (more colloquial)
- {貿易|ぼうえき}: international trade
